## Plain code block

```r
df |>
  filter(cyl == 6) |>
  group_by(gear) |>
  summarise(m = mean(mpg)) |>
  arrange(desc(m))
```

## All 5 diff styles

```{.r data-code-line-diff="+:1,-:2,!:3,#:4,@:5"}
added line (green)
removed line (red)
changed line (orange)
commented line (gray, dimmed)
highlighted line (pink)
```

## Static diff

```{.r data-code-line-diff="-:3,+:3-6"}
df |>
  filter(cyl == 6) |>
  group_by(gear) |>
  summarise(
    m = mean(mpg),
    .by = gear
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(m))
```

## Progressive diff

```{.r data-code-line-diff="|@:2|-:3,+:4-7|@:8"}
df |>
  filter(cyl == 6) |>
  group_by(gear) |>
  summarise(
    m = mean(mpg),
    .by = gear
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(m))
```

## Executable, YAML form

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
#| code-line-diff:
#|   - add: 2-3
#|   - rem: 5
mtcars |>
  dplyr::filter(cyl == 6) |>
  dplyr::group_by(gear) |>
  dplyr::summarise(m = mean(mpg)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(m))
```
